messages:
Aisha: Quick bring-up: ran a short quant sweep on Sprout-10B (fp16 / int8 / int6). Posting the high-level econ vs quality notes.
Ben: Thx — top-level callouts?
Aisha: Throughput/cost: p95 chat latency fp16 320ms / int8 210ms / int6 165-175ms. Normalized unit cost per 1k tokens: fp16 $1.00, int8 $0.62, int6 $0.47.
Carol: Big savings. Any quality regressions?
Aisha: Yes, the longform summarization slice (inputs >1024 tokens) shows ROUGE-L drop ~5.5-6 pts int6 vs fp16. int8 is close to fp16. Instruction pass-rate (500 prompt set): fp16 94%, int8 92%, int6 88%.
Dmitri: Where do regressions concentrate?
Aisha: Multi-step summaries, long contextual reasoning, and some code-gen >40 lines. Safety filters unchanged.
Ben: Suggested rollout idea?
Aisha: Minimal playbook:
- Canary: 5% traffic to int6 for chat-heavy, short-turn flows
- Heuristic routing: treat requests with char_count <6000 and newlines <8 as chat-eligible
- Force int8/fp16 for longform or prompts containing keywords like "multi-step" or "multi-turn"
Carol: Can we avoid full tokenization for routing? Heuristics seem ok.
Dmitri: yep — char_count and newline heuristics are cheap. Also tag slices for monitoring: sprout_longform, sprout_code.
Elaine: Monitoring / gates?
Aisha: Scorecard for canary accept:
- Longform ROUGE-L delta <= 2 pts (sampled)
- Instruction pass-rate drop <= 1.5%
- p95 latency for chat <= 220ms
- Unit cost reduction >= 40% for enabling int6
Ben: Automated alarms I suggest:
- 24h rolling longform ROUGE-L drop >3 -> auto rollback int6 -> int8
- 12h instruction pass-rate drop >2% -> page ML-oncall
- p99 latency +30% -> throttle int6 batch size
Aisha: Quick config snippet for Console rollout template:
```
route_rules:
  - name: sprout-int6-chat
    match: "channel == 'chat' and char_count < 6000 and newlines <= 8"
    percent: 5
    model_variant: sprout-10b-int6
    fallback: sprout-10b-int8
  - name: sprout-longform-default
    match: "char_count >= 6000 or newlines > 8"
    percent: 100
    model_variant: sprout-10b-int8
```
Dmitri: Recommend int8 as default in GTN, int6 as opt-in for cost-conscious chat workloads. Also run a warmstart/caching test — KV cache + 2-step warmstart reduced ROUGE-L delta on int6 from ~6 -> ~3.5 pts in my quick run.
Carol: Good — I'll wire dashboard slices and add per-slice deltas.
Ben: I'll draft GTN blurb: "Sprout-10B — int8 recommended; int6 optional for short-turn conversational flows. Expect ~40-50% unit savings; watch longform summarization. Use routing heuristics and the canary scorecard."
eval-bot: Offline validation: 5k random chat samples -> simulated human pass-rate int6 91% vs int8 93%.
Elaine: Next steps: Aisha push canary config, Carol add dashboards/alerts, Ben publish GTN note. Re-evaluate after 48h of telemetry.
Aisha: Pushing the canary now, will post periodic updates and a short 48h readout. :rocket:
